## ✨ Added
- A dashboard tile with one row per app of your fortress: its state, what needs you, what it is working on and its version. An app that runs on several devices gets one row.
- One log with the lines of every app, newest at the bottom. Click an app, or its button above the log, to see only its lines.
- Join your fortress with its phrase under Settings → Utilities → TollRoll. Every app in the same fortress then shows up by itself, on this server or on another device.
- When your fortress gets a new phrase, TollRoll follows by itself. If it can't, the settings page asks for the new words. Either way it stays the same member, so no duplicate shows up.
- Four views in the tile header: everything, the apps alone, the log alone and a map of the devices and apps in your fortress. The tile remembers your view and the apps you picked for the log, so every browser finds it the way you left it.
- Notifications through Unraid, Apprise or Matrix when an app stops answering, answers again or newly needs you. Each one is sent once.
- Every setting is saved the moment you change it.
- TollRoll keeps only the keys made from your phrase, never the phrase itself. The browser talks only to the Unraid WebGUI, and the service behind it opens no network port.

## 🎨 Design
- Each row shows the app's own logo and colour when its status report has them, and its first letter otherwise. A logo is checked and only ever drawn as an image, so nothing in it can run.
- The log keeps its dark terminal look on every Unraid theme.

## 🌐 Translations
- Every text in all 26 languages Unraid offers. Texts from your apps arrive in your language too, as far as each app has them.
